A "Super Kite" Built by the enigmatic genius known as the Kite Crafter. While these ship designs may hold forms close to the ubiquitous Kite, many debate on whether it still is a Kite on account for the radical overhauls made to the design.

The Vermillion is the Kite Crafter's way of making the Kite into a missile fighter, combining parts and design aspects of the Vigilance and--as rumors say: parts of the Sentry wardrone. In any case, the Vermillion is outfitted with nothing but missile hardpoints and a system to capitalize on it. With the Kite's natural maneuverability and small size, it can fit the role of a support ship or a sneaky finisher.
